verdict.rationale: Unity documents a first-party standalone CLI for installing/managing Editors, automation and CI pipelines, with keyless install script, multi-platform packaging, structured JSON/TSV output, documented exit codes, and even a built-in `unity mcp` server mode plus `unity eval` for direct agent-driven automation — explicitly positioned as faster/token-efficient for AI agents driving shell commands. missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of real-world adoption of this specific CLI (evidence is entirely first-party docs/probes).
